note: REAL local pilot (Ollama qwen2:7b): temperature as noise intervention. Direction-level support only; NOT a replication of the 60-condition grid.
finding: Two real findings: (1) noise direction confirmed — temperature intervention doubles self-eval CV; (2) coupling requires evaluator variance to manifest: at temp0.3 the model emits near-constant confidence (CV~0), so measured coupling collapses to ~0 regardless of true calibration; at temp1.0 coupling becomes visible (0.168). Implication for the paper's tradeoff narrative: any coupling comparison across interventions must first verify the intervention preserves non-degenerate evaluator variance.
